name: Chester and District Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Emergency food parcels with referral. Open Tue and Fri at Frodsham Youth Centre.

name: Cheshire West and Chester Council Allotments
description: Two sites including Frodsham Leisure Centre and Manor Road. Plots from £35/year. Water and storage facilities available.

name: Frodsham Community Garden
description: Located by the River Weaver. Volunteer project growing seasonal vegetables. Surplus produce shared with local families and food bank.
